package.name: satellite_grasp_planner
package.description: Grasp planner for model-mediated teleoperated grasping of a rotating target satellite (selectGraspS3, legacy or v2 mode; the node parameters and the planGraspAndLaunchS1 entry point keep the "s1" name): picks the grasp point k and phase theta whose position is closest to the deformation of the single demo, subject to IK and trust-radius constraints (legacy mode also manipulability and static joint margin; v2 mode optionally a predicted joint margin and a hand-satellite clearance), checks velocity and kinematic path a posteriori, and plans the launch time.
